project_type.description: Optional route marker, purely additive (grease step 8). Only the exact value PRECISION_GREASE_DEV activates the grease-route rules (small sequential rounds of 3-6 samples per round, honest sequential method name, bench-schedule hard constraint). Absent or any other value keeps the pre-existing oil-route behaviour byte for byte. The skill layer fills this from the validated project artifact, whose project_type enum is the authority.

bench_artifact.description: Optional registered bench object (grease step 8, plan section 7.2 D-4). The engine consumes exactly one field of it: available_bench_slots, the value DERIVED by bench-registration (floor(usable_days/cycle_days) summed over availability_window, asserted by validate_bench_artifact.py). Supplying it turns the hand-filled resource_envelope.bench_slots into a checked declaration: a contradiction is rejected, and the design size must not exceed the derived capacity. The embedded artifact is validated by its own authority contract (bench.schema.json); this container deliberately stays open instead of mirroring that contract, so the two lists cannot drift.

resource_envelope.description: WP-04b resource envelope for the factor / process channels. bench_slots is the number of concurrent bench positions available for the NEXT round; its conversion basis references `bench.availability_window` (WP-05) and is documented rather than enforced here because the bench object does not exist yet. Fields are declared, not silently defaulted: the engine reports whatever it cannot yet consume. Optional in the compute contract (backward compatible with pre-WP-04b inputs); required on the experiment_design request for the factor families.

process_factor_role.description: WP-04b: process-level split-plot role, mirroring process.schema.json factor_role. A factor that omits its own `role` inherits this value, so the whole/sub-plot direction is decided by process data and never hardcoded in the engine.

factors.description: Independent (not mixture-closed) design dimensions. WP-04a supports two-level factors only: a factor varies between exactly two levels (explicit levels[] or a range[low,high]) or is held constant at hold_at and contributes no column. role records the split-plot structure: WHOLE_PLOT factors are hard to change, SUB_PLOT factors are reset per run. This role is orthogonal to design_space.constraint_role. WP-04b: role is optional per factor and falls back to process_factor_role.

design_type.description: Grease step 8 (purely additive enum value): RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED_GREEDY_SEQUENTIAL is the honest name for what the engine actually runs on this channel -- deterministic greedy selection from candidate lattice points, not model-driven sequential design (there is no Gaussian process). BAYESIAN_SEQUENTIAL stays a working alias and keeps emitting its legacy method string, so pre-rename inputs are unchanged.
